summary:
**The Astral Archives** is an interactive, story-driven educational game designed to make space science and engineering accessible, engaging, and exciting for younger generations.

Players become Henda, an aerospace engineer investigating five fictional space mission cases inspired by NASA resources and real engineering challenges. Through interactive rooms, connected evidence, cinematic storytelling, and scientific discoveries, players uncover what went wrong in each mission.

After investigating, players travel back in time to rescue the missions by applying their knowledge through practical engineering decisions involving spacecraft design, materials, power, navigation, and testing. Every decision introduces consequences and trade-offs, encouraging critical thinking instead of memorization.

Built using React, TypeScript, and interactive 2D visuals, our game transforms complex NASA engineering concepts into an immersive learning experience.

**Our goal is to inspire the next generation of space explorers by turning scientific knowledge into curiosity, discovery, and meaningful action.**
details:
The Astral Archives is an interactive educational game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to make space science and engineering more engaging and accessible.

Players become Henda, an aerospace engineer, investigating five fictional space mission failures inspired by real engineering challenges. They explore interactive rooms, collect connected evidence, and uncover the story behind each mission.

After investigating, players travel back in time to rescue the missions by applying what they learned through engineering decisions involving spacecraft design, power, materials, navigation, and testing. Their choices have consequences, encouraging critical thinking and problem-solving rather than memorization.

Technology: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS, Web Audio API, GitHub, Vercel, AI-assisted design tools, and NASA educational resources.

Our goal is to transform complex scientific concepts into an immersive, story-driven experience that inspires young people to explore space science and learn by doing.
